title: PRD-16 synthetic risk input syntax

deviceModelCode.description: required; catalog/contract mapping <= 80. Sensitivity: internal. Error: DEVICE_MODEL_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

deviceIdentifier.description: required; 1–64 characters; scheme-specific validation, encrypt/mask. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: DEVICE_IDENTIFIER_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

purchaseDate.description: required; nonfuture; calendar source explicit. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PURCHASE_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

declaredValue.description: required; positive explicit currency/unit. Sensitivity: financial. Error: DEVICE_VALUE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

conditionCode.description: required; contract-offered new/used/reconditioned category. Sensitivity: internal. Error: CONDITION_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

purchaseEvidenceRef.description: conditional; authorized invoice/ownership evidence. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PURCHASE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

inspectionRef.description: conditional; approved device/condition check. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: DEVICE_INSPECTION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

perilPlanCode.description: required; offered damage/theft/other structure. Sensitivity: internal. Error: DEVICE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
